description: Texas/ERCOT energy price DAG. Upstream (45 Ridge vars R²=0.76 + 9 disruption vars R²=0.315) -> Henry Hub -> ERCOT Wholesale (R²=0.653) -> TX Retail (R²=0.298). Gas is the marginal price setter (42% share). Energy-only market with high volatility.
